name: Congenital Pulmonary Airway Malformation Type 1

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Radiologic and Histopathologic Diagnostic Criteria for CPAM

criteria.description: Presence of large cystic lesions (>2 cm) within the affected lung lobe on imaging
Histopathologic confirmation showing cysts lined by ciliated pseudostratified columnar epithelium with mucous cells
No evidence of other congenital lung malformations such as bronchopulmonary sequestration

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic cystic lesions on imaging plus histopathologic confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Prenatal ultrasound and postnatal CT imaging are critical for diagnosis; histopathology confirms subtype.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Large cystic lung lesions detected on imaging
pathognomonic.notes: Typically unilateral and localized to one lobe
searchTerms: large lung cysts seen on scans

common.symptomName: Decreased breath sounds over affected lung
searchTerms: reduced breath sounds over lung area
poor sucking or swallowing in neonates

laboratory: Non-specific inflammatory markers may be elevated during infection
imaging: Prenatal ultrasound showing cystic lung lesions
CT scan demonstrating large cystic lesions with air-fluid levels
genetic: No consistent genetic mutations identified; sporadic occurrence
other: Histopathology showing cysts lined by ciliated pseudostratified columnar epithelium with mucous cells

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of systemic arterial supply from the aorta
Lined by respiratory epithelium without mucous cells

redFlags: Severe neonatal respiratory distress requiring ventilation
Rapidly enlarging cystic lung mass causing mediastinal shift
references: Stocker JT. Congenital pulmonary airway malformation: a new name for and expanded classification of congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation of the lung. Histopathology. 2002.
Clement WA, et al. Congenital pulmonary airway malformation: diagnosis and management. Paediatr Respir Rev. 2014.
Orphanet: Congenital pulmonary airway malformation type 1. ORPHA:280832.
